title: feat(full-core): bind the defined today initial-stock kind as the sole live KIND_SET member
body:
## Summary

- Candidate ≠ ratification ≠ anchor ≠ KIND_SET membership remains exact. Venue `eq` stays non-source. Zero GET/POST. Protected surfaces unchanged. BT/BU/BV packs not rewritten.
- After bind: `SOURCE_KIND_STATUS=DEFINED_KIND_SET_MEMBER`, `MEMBERSHIP_OWNER_RATIFICATION_REQUIRED=false`, live KIND_SET singleton only. Next blocker remains D6 classified-event-stream completeness; reconstruction is not started.
